summary: Georgia lookout list places a Bascom tower in Screven County at 229 ft; no source found gives its history or describes the site today. The NHLR Sylvania tower is a separate site.

evidence.supports: Bascom tower listed in Screven County at 32.85659, -81.63722, 229 ft
Directory lists a Bascom entry in Screven County with no other detail
Sylvania Lookout Tower registered in Screven County at 32.764960, -81.649550
The register's tower is the Sylvania Lookout Tower in Screven County

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a tower-list row (coordinates, elevation, county) and a name-only directory entry. No source gives a build date, design, staffing, or whether the tower stands, so the story has no built, staffing or fate section and the status stays unknown. Two searches found no tower history for Bascom. The NHLR Sylvania tower (US 957, GA 15, registered 2013) is about 10 km south of the Bascom row, using the two coordinate pairs; it is a different site, so the Bascom row should not be merged with it. The brief's record has no errors to correct. The list gives elevations as bare numbers with no unit; feet is inferred from the values (the Brasstown row's 4735 fits feet only; as metres it would be over 15,000 ft, above Georgia's highest point), and the story keeps the house feet-first style on that basis.
